verdict.rationale: Brevo documents tracking custom user events via JavaScript or REST APIs and offers unlimited automated multi-step workflows, and custom events can drive segmentation. The evidence never explicitly says a custom event fired from your product can trigger a workflow for the specific contact who generated it, so the core link is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that custom events act as automation triggers, per-contact event-to-workflow binding details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can fire a custom event from my product and have it trigger an automation for exactly that person

citations.quote: Track custom user events and behaviors. Monitor website activity and measure engagement with JavaScript or REST APIs.
Create an unlimited number of automated, multi-step workflows to engage users at key moments along their journey.
Search, save, and manage contacts with filters like demographics, website activity, campaign engagement, and custom events.
